text: MCP surface for black-box repo links (list/register/link/unlink + visible supportingRepos)
description:
Repo-level cross-repo links are GUI-only: the MCP server exposes no repo-link tools, and get_aim/get_aim_context omit supportingRepos, so an agent can neither see that an external repo carries part of an aim nor create such a link. The backend already has everything (linkedRepo.list/register/unregister/resolve, aim.linkRepo/unlinkRepo) — this is a thin MCP wrapper over it.

SCOPE: list_linked_repos, register_linked_repo, link_repo, unlink_repo; plus supportingRepos surfaced (with repo names resolved from the registry) in get_aim and as supporting_repos in get_aim_context.

BLACK BOX HOLDS: every tool takes {repoId} only, never an external aimId, and none of them reads the linked repo's aims. Link health stays minimal — resolved / not-checked-out / unknown-repo — not the per-edge vocabulary cancelled in f2e3dad3.

status.comment: Implemented and internally verified; awaiting user acceptance (and a first real link through the reconnected MCP server).

valueRationale: Unblocks agents from participating in cross-repo structure at all; without it the feature only exists for a human clicking in the GUI, which contradicts the human-AI cooperation thesis.
reflection: Added four tools to packages/mcp/src/tools.ts over existing tRPC procedures — list_linked_repos, register_linked_repo, link_repo, unlink_repo — plus a describeRepoEdges helper that resolves each {repoId} edge to a name and a three-state health (resolved / not-checked-out / unknown-repo), wired into get_aim and as supporting_repos in get_aim_context. link_repo rejects a repoId absent from the registry and names the known repos, so an agent cannot write an edge that drains value into a dead sink. Verification: 3 new node:test cases in tools-repo-links.test.ts (round-trip register→link→read→unlink, unregistered-repoId refusal, not-checked-out degradation) pass against the real backend router; MCP suite 29 pass / 2 fail where both failures (Project Meta, Consistency) reproduce on a stashed baseline and are unrelated; mcp tsc clean; backend linked-repos + repo-connections 15 pass. Also corrected a stale backend comment that described linkedRepo.resolve as a step toward loading external aims.
